messages:
jessica (prod): Quick async QTR check — please drop a 1-line status per milestone (shipped / slipped / next) by EOD. Focus: Embed Store, Dedicated Autoscaler, Console rollout. I’ll compile for the exec pulse.

srini (eng-runtime): Embed Store: core API + prefix caching shipped. Slipped: metrics dashboard (blocked on metrics lib upgrade). Next: finalize dashboard + add perf alerts. Owner: srini. CR ping @nina for metrics PR #482.

nina (eng-ml): PR #482 review done, left comments on eval harness and dataset split. ETA for fixes: 48h. Noticed small embedding quality drift on helm-2-quant — running evals now.

omar (eng-sre): Dedicated Autoscaler: baseline autoscale shipped to canary. Slipped: burst policy + quota handling (cloud quota request pending). Next: escalate quota + finish e2e test. Impact: potential 2-3% latency under sustained bursts. Owner: omar.

paul (design): Console rollout: internal beta shipped for 3 orgs. Public copy + tooltip polish slipped one sprint. Next: design review Tues, then handoff. Need content from product for billing copy.

ariya (eng): CR ping @srini @nina — I can take the first pass tonight. Heads up: dev cluster showed flakiness during canary; I added a small routing config: `env=REDWOOD_CANARY=true` for canary routing.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: embed-store:v2 -> infra-2 cluster. Link: https://deploys/redwood/1234 :rocket:

srini (eng-runtime): Thanks @ariya. Blocker: we’re seeing a KV-cache mem increase after ~10k tokens on long chat sessions. Nina, can you run mem-profiler with 5k+ seqs and attach heap dump? Tagging @omar for observability reads.

nina (eng-ml): I'll kick the profile but need a longer-run GPU for stable reproductions (6+ hours). @jessica can we get a perf-gpu slot for a few days?

jessica (prod): Approved: one-week access to perf-gpu-1 for mem profiling. @platform-ops please grant.

omar (eng-sre): Got it — creating ticket for temp creds and kube access. Also flagging billing team: autoscaler quota will need sign-off for burst increases. cc: @finance.

jessica (prod): Thanks all — I'll collate these into an EOD digest with owners and next steps. If anything becomes a release-blocker, escalate in #incidents or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
